description: Compresses a raw conversation transcript into a structured ContextBridge handoff block.

provider.description: Optional provider override for the extraction lane: openai, openai-chat, google, groq, custom, or hosted.

transcript.description: The raw conversation transcript to compress.

name: compress_context

constraints_and_preferences.description: Important user preferences, constraints, or non-negotiables.

conversation_significance.description: Whether the conversation carries durable context worth porting.

rationale.description: Why this conversation was classified this way.

should_capture_full_context.description: Whether the conversation deserves a full continuity handoff.

conversation_type.description: The dominant type of work the conversation is doing.

current_state.description: A concise description of where the work currently stands, weighted toward the final 25% of the conversation.

decisions_made.description: Only decisions explicitly confirmed, chosen, or accepted by the user. Suggestions alone do not count.

decision.description: A decision explicitly confirmed or chosen by the user.

why.description: Why that decision was made, or null when the rationale was not explicit.

goal.description: The user's primary goal as of the latest meaningful state in the transcript.

key_artifacts.description: Important outputs, files, prompts, or assets mentioned in the transcript.

description.description: Why this artifact matters to resuming the conversation.

kind.description: Artifact type such as code, doc, config, prompt, dataset, or file.

location.description: A file path, URL, or reference if the transcript provided one.

name.description: Artifact name or a short label.

open_threads.description: Unresolved work, risks, or follow-ups that still need attention.

next_step.description: The best immediate next step for this thread, or null if unclear.

status.description: The current status of that thread in one concise sentence.

detected.description: Whether the final portion of the conversation changed direction.

evidence.description: A short description of the turn or shift that caused the pivot.

from_topic.description: The earlier direction before the pivot, or null if no pivot occurred.

to_topic.description: The newer direction after the pivot, or null if no pivot occurred.

suggested_next_step.description: The best immediate next action for continuing the conversation.

user_expertise_level.description: Estimated expertise level implied by the user's language and requests.

title: Compress Context
